learning_objective: 🎯 Become a master reader who can quickly scan, skim, and extract secret information from any passage like a detective!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: An unseen passage is a story, article, or poem you have never read before! Your goal is to read it, understand the main idea, and answer questions. It tests your brain's ability to process new information quickly.

Skimming is reading super fast just to get the MAIN IDEA. You do not read every single word. You just read the title, the first sentence of each paragraph, and the last sentence to know what the text is about. It is like looking at a map before a journey!

Scanning is when you look for a SPECIFIC detail, like a date, a name, or a number. You move your eyes quickly over the text without reading until you spot the exact word you need. Think of it like searching for your friend in a big crowd!

Sometimes the answer is not written directly in the text. You have to 'infer' or guess based on clues. If the text says 'Raju wiped the sweat from his forehead and drank a whole bottle of water', you can INFER that it is a very hot day, even if the text does not say the word 'hot'!

Step 1: Read the QUESTIONS first! (This tells your brain what to look for). Step 2: Skim the passage for the main idea. Step 3: Scan the passage to find the exact answers to the questions. Never just start reading without a plan!

fun_activity.title: 🕵️‍♂️ The 30-Second Scan
fun_activity.instructions: Take a random page of a newspaper or magazine. Ask a parent to give you a specific word to find. Time yourself! Can you scan the whole page and point to the word in under 30 seconds?

quick_recap: ⭐ Comprehension means understanding what you read.
⭐ Always read the questions BEFORE you read the passage so you know what to look for.
⭐ Skim to find the general topic and main idea of the passage quickly.
⭐ Scan to find specific facts, dates, names, or numbers.
⭐ Use clues in the text to infer (guess) meanings that are not directly stated.
